SELECT intent_type AS intent_type, SUM(CASE WHEN is_liked = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_liked = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disliked_count FROM user_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND intent_type IS NOT NULL
AND user_id IN (SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_by = #{createdBy})
GROUP BY intent_type ORDER BY intent_type

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_liked = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked_count FROM user_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_at >= #{start}
AND user_id IN (SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = 0 AND created_by = #{createdBy})
